description: Search the SkillMD registry of Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) by task, name or keywords. Returns matching skills with their owner/name slug, description, category, safety verdict and install snippet, best match first.

category.description: Restrict to one category slug, e.g. coding, devops, data, security

query.description: Natural-language query or keywords describing the task or skill

type.description: Restrict to single-file skills or multi-file packs

verified_only.description: Return only skills from verified publishers (default false)

name: skillmd_search

items.description: A skill as listed in search and leaderboard results.

agents.description: Agent ids the skill is published for

ai_audit_verdict.description: Safety review verdict: pass, caution, warning, fail or inconclusive

description.description: What the skill does and when an agent should use it

repo_stars.description: GitHub stars of the source repository

security_flags.description: Capability flags: docs_only, network_calls, executes_scripts, reads_secrets, untrusted_install

verdict.description: Safety verdict from the registry's audits

title: Search skills
